issue: All summary percentiles were present, but fresh per-scene directories did not exist when the cost exporter attempted tick/counter output. The immutable Q binary has the same behavior.
remedy: The native supervisor now creates all four scene directories before either binary starts; rerun the entire balanced schedule in a fresh matrix directory. The analyzer now requires 240 raw tick records and effective per-scene parameters.
direct_cli_precondition: Use profile-pbf.ps1/profile-cost.ps1 or pre-create the four scene folders when using --gpu-cost-profile directly.
